config.install.title: Faz AI: Installation
config.install.environment: The Environment Diagnostics shows what the board needs on this machine, why, and how to fix it, with one-click install. [Open the Environment Diagnostics](command:fazai.openEnvironment)
config.appearance.title: Faz AI: Appearance
config.appearance.language: Language of the board interface. `auto` follows the editor language. The other appearance options (theme, font, status names) are coming in the next versions; until then, use [Appearance in the board](command:fazai.openBoardSettings?%5B%7B%22tab%22%3A%22appearance%22%7D%5D).
config.git.title: Faz AI: Git
config.git.info: Branch and worktree options are coming to the Settings in the next versions. Until then, use [Git in the board settings](command:fazai.openBoardSettings?%5B%7B%22tab%22%3A%22git%22%7D%5D).
config.backup.title: Faz AI: Backup
config.backup.info: Export and import are coming as editor commands in the next versions. Until then, use [Backup in the board settings](command:fazai.openBoardSettings?%5B%7B%22tab%22%3A%22backup%22%7D%5D).
